Fought in 1904–05 over rival ambitions in Manchuria and Korea, this war's great clashes raged near Mukden on land and across the Yellow Sea and the Sea of Japan — what was it?
Russo-Japanese War (8 February 1904 - 5 September 1905) was fought between the Russian Empire and the Empire of Japan over rival imperial ambitions in Manchuria and the Korean Empire.
Inspired by a 1990 nonfiction book, this TV drama follows a high school football team and its coach, played by Kyle Chandler, in a tight-knit fictional West Texas town — what show is it?
Friday Night Lights (TV series) is an American sports drama television series developed by Peter Berg and inspired by a 1990 book of immersive journalism by H. G. Bissinger.
In this learning process, voluntary behaviors grow more frequent through reinforcement or fade through punishment and extinction — what is it called?
Operant conditioning is a learning process in which voluntary behaviors are modified by association with the addition (or removal) of reward or aversive stimuli.
